preregistration.name: LSTM attribution repeatability and SGAE benefit (confirmatory, test set)
preregistration.statistic: D = [PR-AUC(sgae_tuned) - PR-AUC(tuned_constant)] in HIGH tertile minus the same difference in LOW tertile
preregistration.inference: paired bootstrap over card keys, 2,000 resamples, one-sided 95% interval
preregistration.H1: D > 0 (SGAE helps more where LSTM attributions are more repeatable)
preregistration.interpretation_limit: repeatability is not faithfulness; a positive D is consistent with, not proof of, the mechanism
